title: Fix a script and total reports in folders with spaces and Cyrillic names
prompt:
The folder `Отчёты 2025` holds our monthly expense reports for the first quarter. `tools & scripts/sum report.py` is supposed to print the total per category for one report (`python "tools & scripts/sum report.py" <report.csv>`), but it has been failing since we moved to this PC. Fix it, keeping it a command-line script that takes the report's path.

Then write `Итоги/2025 Q1.json` with the totals of all three reports, in this shape, totals as numbers rounded to 2 decimals:

{"Январь": {"<категория>": <total>, ...}, "Февраль": {...}, "Март": {...}, "всего": <grand total of the quarter>}

Don't rename or move the reports.
